description: JD-driven tutorial suggestion, review / accept surface (78-band). The last band of the funnel: an in-app view to review, edit, drop, or accept the deduplicated suggestions from 77 — and, on accept, hand the suggestion to the SHIPPED subject flow (POST /api/subjects -> scaffold -> construct) as just a new entry point, adding the front of the funnel, not a second constructor. This is the join back into the existing pipeline: an accepted suggestion becomes a subject goal that curriculum_gen builds exactly as a hand-typed goal would. It spans the launcher API (serve/accept suggestions) and the UI (the review surface), reusing the construction job machinery (useConstruction, GET/POST /api/construct) unchanged. Depends on 77 (there must be a deduplicated suggestion set to review). Anti-fabrication: 'accept' is real only when it reaches the existing POST /api/subjects and yields a persisted curriculum on the storage backend — never a suggestion marked accepted with nothing scaffolded; a smoke test proves an accepted suggestion produces real notebooks on disk.
warmup: echo '--- the shipped subject/scaffold/construct entry points to reuse ---'; sed -n '16,25p' launcher/app.py
echo '--- the single construction poller held at the app top ---'; grep -rn 'useConstruction\|/api/construct\|DefineSubject' ui/src/App.tsx | head
echo '--- cross-origin is gated, never widened ---'; grep -n 'SHELL_ORIGIN_RE' launcher/app.py

userStories.title: Serve and mutate the suggestion set over the launcher
acceptanceCriteria: The launcher exposes endpoints to list the deduplicated suggestions for an ingested JD (each with its source requirement and gap rationale) and to edit / drop / accept one; every mutating call honors the writable() 503 middleware like the other non-GET writes.

Accepting a suggestion calls the SHIPPED POST /api/subjects path with the suggestion's goal (no new curriculum generator, no second constructor) and returns the created subject slug so the client can drive the existing scaffold + construct flow.

Gate green: python3 -m pytest -q tests/ passes with the launch extra, including a test that accepting a suggestion creates a persisted subject via the existing subjects endpoint and that a dropped suggestion is gone from the list.
userStories.notes: uv run --with '.[launch,dev]' pytest -q: 964 passed, 0 failed; focused smoke test confirmed accept persists a subject and drop removes the suggestion

userStories.title: In-app review / edit / drop / accept view
acceptanceCriteria: A UI surface renders the suggestions with their rationale, lets the user edit the goal text, drop unwanted ones, and accept the rest; accepting routes into the existing define -> scaffold -> construct experience (the single useConstruction poller held at the top of App.tsx), so a run started here is the run the rest of the app shows.
The surface holds no suggestion or unlock logic of its own — it renders whatever the launcher describes and calls back, mirroring how KnowledgeChecks.tsx renders whatever the gate says.

Gate green: npm run build in ui/ and cargo build in src-tauri/ pass, python3 -m pytest -q tests/ covers the accept->subject path, and the progress log documents an end-to-end JD -> suggestion -> accept -> scaffolded notebooks run.
userStories.notes: UI review surface wired to launcher suggestions: npm run build green; cargo build green; python3 -m pytest -q tests/: 908 passed, 1 skipped. Accepted suggestions route to the existing subject review, scaffold, and App-owned construction poller.
